description: This header defines template classes and functions for vectorized operations on quantized types (qint8, quint8, qint32) using SVE (Scalable Vector Extension) intrinsics. It provides efficient conversions between quantized types and float vectors, including dequantization, quantization, and element-wise operations, primarily for bandwidth-bound kernel implementations.

classes.name: VectorizedQuantizedConverter
classes.description: Template class providing conversion and dequantization operations for quantized types using SVE.

classes.name: Vectorized<c10::qint32>
classes.description: Specialization of Vectorized for qint32 type, supporting dequantization and quantization.

classes.name: Vectorized<c10::qint8>
classes.description: Specialization of Vectorized for qint8 type, supporting dequantization, quantization, and element-wise operations.

classes.name: Vectorized<c10::quint8>
classes.description: Specialization of Vectorized for quint8 type, supporting dequantization, quantization, and element-wise operations.

methods.name: dequantize
methods.description: Converts quantized vector data to float vectors using scale and zero point.

methods.name: quantize
methods.description: Converts float vectors to quantized types using scale and zero point.

methods.name: maximum
methods.description: Element-wise maximum of two quantized vectors.

methods.name: loadu
methods.description: Loads unaligned data into quantized vector types.
